ids.681:
Technical notes on the raw files

Column names in the Order file use decomposed Unicode (NFD). The tool normalises to NFC before matching; otherwise columns with diacritics would not be found.
Shopee's Product Master file has a non-standard XML attribute (activePane="bottom_left") that makes some libraries refuse to read it. The reader in this tool skips that error.
Amounts like "2.659.908.662" use a dot as thousands separator, and percentages like "3,27%" use a comma as decimal separator. The tool detects this per cell.
